-                     &lt;p&gt;"Sustainable" means nothing until it's "2.3kg CO₂ saved." Turning eco-impact into numbers makes it real, shareable, and motivating. Gamification (Earth Guardian levels) adds emotional reward.&lt;/p&gt;

+     &lt;!-- Design Challenges Section --&gt;
+     &lt;section class="section challenges-section"&gt;
+         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
+             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;DESIGN CHALLENGES&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;UX Obstacles &amp; Solutions&lt;/h2&gt;
+             &lt;p class="section-subtitle animate-on-scroll"&gt;Key design challenges and how I addressed them&lt;/p&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="challenges-grid"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;01&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Multiple Markets, One Interface&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Cities have dozens of farmers markets with different schedules, locations, and vendors, which can be overwhelming to track&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Calendar-style date badges, location-based sorting, favorite markets list, and clear "This Week" grouping to surface what's relevant now&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;02&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Social Without Being Creepy&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Users want to know who's attending, but location-based social features can feel invasive&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Opt-in "I'm Going" model: you only appear if you actively mark attendance. Friends-only visibility options. No real-time location tracking&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;03&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Vendor Continuity Across Markets&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Users find a great vendor at one market but don't know where else they sell. Vendors often appear at multiple markets&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Unified vendor profiles showing all markets they attend, follow functionality with notifications, and "Where are they this week?" discovery&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;04&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Encouraging Commitment&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Users browse markets but don't commit to going, showing high intent but low follow-through&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
+                             &lt;p&gt;Social proof ("Sarah &amp; 2 friends going"), prominent "I'm Going" CTA, reminder notifications, and FOMO-inducing friend activity feeds&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;

+             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;What I Accomplished &amp; Learned&lt;/h2&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="results-grid"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="result-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;

+                     &lt;p&gt;Markets discovery, social going, vendor tracking&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="result-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="result-number"&gt;5&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="result-label"&gt;Social Mechanisms&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Who's going, friend activity, invites, coordination&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="result-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="result-number"&gt;1&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="result-label"&gt;Working Prototype&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Fully interactive HTML/CSS/JS simulation&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="learnings-grid"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;💡&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Trust Is the Product&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;In a marketplace connecting strangers, every design decision must answer: "Does this make users feel safe?" Verified badges, ratings, and messaging aren't just features; they're the foundation.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🎯&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Quantify the Abstract&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;"Sustainable" means nothing until it's "2.3kg CO₂ saved." Turning eco-impact into numbers makes it real, shareable, and motivating. Gamification (Earth Guardian levels) adds emotional reward.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🎨&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Design Signals Quality&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Users judge reliability by aesthetics before functionality. The polished green theme and Fraunces typography signal "premium" and "trustworthy," which is critical for food purchases from strangers.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🔄&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Two Users, One Vision&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Designing for both farmers and buyers required understanding their opposing pain points, then finding features that solve both: direct messaging helps buyers trust AND helps farmers explain.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/section&gt;
+ 
+     &lt;!-- Reflection Section --&gt;
+     &lt;section class="section reflection-section"&gt;
+         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
+             &lt;div class="reflection-content animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="section-label"&gt;REFLECTION&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;h2&gt;Personal Takeaways&lt;/h2&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="reflection-text"&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;This project taught me that sustainable design isn't just about environmental impact. It's about creating systems that sustain trust, relationships, and communities. The Locavore movement isn't just about food miles; it's about reconnecting people with their food sources and each other.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;The most challenging aspect was designing for two fundamentally different user types with opposing needs. Farmers need efficient tools to list products and manage orders; buyers need confidence-building features and easy discovery. Finding the overlap (direct messaging, verified profiles, transparent pricing) was the key insight.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;If I were to start over, I would conduct more in-depth farmer interviews earlier in the process. While buyer needs are well-documented in market research, farmer pain points around technology adoption and digital literacy would benefit from more ethnographic research.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/section&gt;
+ 
+     &lt;!-- Next Steps Section --&gt;
+     &lt;section class="section next-steps-section"&gt;
+         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
+             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;NEXT STEPS&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;Future Design Iterations&lt;/h2&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="next-steps-grid"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="next-step-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="next-step-number"&gt;01&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;User Testing&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Validate assumptions with real farmers and eco-conscious consumers to identify missed pain points&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="next-step-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="next-step-number"&gt;02&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Farmer Dashboard&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Design dedicated interface for farmers to manage inventory, view analytics, and respond to orders&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="next-step-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;

## Simulated User Interviews

### Interview 1: Sarah, 32, Marketing Manager

- "I feel good about buying local but I don't really know how much of a difference it makes."
- "I wish I could see what vendors will be there before I go."
- "Coordinating with friends via text is such a hassle - someone always misses the message."

### Interview 2: Marcus, 45, Software Engineer
**Context:** Regular market-goer, goes almost every week, often alone

**Key Quotes/Insights:**

- "I'd love to know if my neighbors are going - could carpool."

- "I try to buy local to reduce my carbon footprint but it's hard to track."
- "Winter hours always throw me off - suddenly it's 9-1 instead of 8-2."
- "Would be nice to get a reminder the night before."

- "I don't know who sells what - I just wander around."
- "I like supporting local farmers but supermarkets are just easier."
- "Is there an app for this? I'd use it."
- "The community vibe is nice - saw some friends there unexpectedly."

Now let me organize these into the 4 clusters:

### Scheduling & Memory (from all three interviews)
Sarah forgets when markets happen and misses peak shopping times. Marcus struggles with varying schedules and winter hour changes. Elena showed up to a closed market because she had the wrong week. All three need better reminders and clearer scheduling information.

### Social & Community Connection
Sarah and Elena both mention wanting to coordinate with friends but struggle with logistics. Marcus is interested in knowing if neighbors are attending for carpooling. There's untapped potential for social features that help people discover they share this interest.

### Vendor Discovery & Loyalty
Sarah can't find her favorite honey vendor across different markets. Marcus wants to track down the cheese vendor from another location. Elena doesn't know what vendors sell, so she just wanders. People want to follow specific vendors and see their schedules.

### Impact & Values
Both Sarah and Marcus care about local impact and carbon footprint but lack visibility into the actual difference they're making. Elena appreciates the community aspect but finds supermarkets more convenient. The app could help quantify and celebrate their positive choices. The impact and values theme emerged from three participants who expressed tension between wanting to support local agriculture and sustainability, but lacking visibility into the actual difference their choices make. - /* ===== Affinity Diagram Section ===== */

- /* Affinity Board Container */

-     background: #f8fafc;
-     border-radius: 24px;
-     overflow: hidden;
-     margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
-     box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
-     border: 1px solid var(--neutral-200);
- }
- 
- .affinity-board-header {
-     display: flex;
-     justify-content: space-between;
-     align-items: center;
-     padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl);
-     background: white;
-     border-bottom: 1px solid var(--neutral-100);
- }
- 
- .board-label {
-     font-size: 11px;
-     font-weight: 700;
-     letter-spacing: 2px;
-     text-transform: uppercase;
-     color: var(--neutral-400);

-     font-size: 13px;

- /* The 2x2 Grid Board */
- .affinity-board-grid {
-     display: grid;
-     grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
-     grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
-     min-height: 700px;
- }

- /* Individual Cluster */

-     position: relative;
-     padding: var(--space-lg);
-     border: 1px dashed var(--neutral-200);
-     overflow: hidden;
- }
- 
- .affinity-cluster:nth-child(1) { border-right: 1px dashed var(--neutral-300); border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--neutral-300); }
- .affinity-cluster:nth-child(2) { border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--neutral-300); }
- .affinity-cluster:nth-child(3) { border-right: 1px dashed var(--neutral-300); }
- 
- /* Background watermark label */
- .cluster-bg-label {
-     position: absolute;
-     top: 50%;
-     left: 50%;
-     transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
-     font-family: var(--font-display);
-     font-size: clamp(48px, 8vw, 80px);
-     font-weight: 700;
-     text-transform: uppercase;
-     letter-spacing: 8px;
-     color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
-     pointer-events: none;
-     white-space: nowrap;
- }

- /* Cluster Header */

-     display: flex;
-     align-items: center;
-     gap: var(--space-sm);

-     gap: 8px;
-     padding: var(--space-sm);
-     min-height: 200px;
-     align-content: flex-start;
- }

- /* Individual Sticky Note */

-     width: calc(50% - 4px);
-     min-height: 80px;
-     padding: 10px 8px;
-     border-radius: 2px;
-     display: flex;
-     align-items: center;
-     justify-content: center;
-     text-align: center;
-     transform: rotate(var(--rotation, 0deg));
-     box-shadow: 2px 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
-     transition: transform 0.2s ease;
- }

- .sticky-note:hover {
-     transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.02);
-     z-index: 2;

- /* ===== Animations ===== */
- @keyframes float {
-     0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
-     50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
- }
- 
- @keyframes bounce {
-     0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
-     50% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px); }
- }
- 
- @keyframes pulse-slow {
-     0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
-     50% { opacity: 0.8; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.1); }
- }
- 
- /* Scroll animations */
- .animate-on-scroll {
-     opacity: 1;
-     transform: translateY(0);
-     transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
-     transition-delay: var(--delay, 0s);
- }
- 
- /* Only hide elements when JS is ready to animate them */
- .js-ready .animate-on-scroll {
-     opacity: 0;
-     transform: translateY(30px);
- }
- 
- .js-ready .animate-on-scroll.visible,
- .animate-on-scroll.visible {
-     opacity: 1;
-     transform: translateY(0);
- }
-

- @media (max-width: 1024px) {
-     .problem-grid {

+ /* Affinity Board Container */

+     display: grid;
+     grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
+     gap: var(--space-xl);
+ }
+ 
+ @media (max-width: 768px) {
+     .impact-grid {
+         grid-template-columns: 1fr;
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ .impact-card {
+     background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
+     backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
+     border-radius: 20px;
+     padding: var(--space-xl);
+     text-align: center;
+     border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
+     transition: var(--transition-normal);
+ }
+ 
+ .impact-card:hover {
+     transform: translateY(-8px);
+     background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
+ }
+ 
+ .impact-icon {
+     font-size: 48px;
+     margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
+ }
+ 
+ .impact-metric {
+     font-family: var(--font-display);
+     font-size: 48px;
+     font-weight: 700;
+     color: var(--primary-200);
+     line-height: 1;
+ }
+ 
+ .impact-title {
+     font-size: 18px;
+     font-weight: 600;
+     margin: var(--space-md) 0 var(--space-sm);
+ }
+ 
+ .impact-desc {
+     font-size: 14px;
+     color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
+     line-height: 1.6;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ===== Responsive for new sections ===== */
+ @media (max-width: 1024px) {
+     .competitive-row {
+         grid-template-columns: 140px repeat(4, 1fr);
+     }
+     
+     .phase-content {
+         grid-template-columns: 1fr;
+     }
+

+         grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
+     }

+ 
+ @media (max-width: 768px) {

+     .competitive-row {
+         min-width: 700px;

+     
+     .methodology-phase::before {
+         left: -32px;

+     
+     .usability-overview {
+         grid-template-columns: 1fr;

+

+ /* ===== Animations ===== */
+ @keyframes float {
+     0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
+     50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }

+ 
+ @keyframes bounce {
+     0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
+     50% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px); }
+ }
+ 
+ @keyframes pulse-slow {
+     0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
+     50% { opacity: 0.8; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.1); }
+ }
+ 
+ /* Scroll animations */
+ .animate-on-scroll {

+     transform: translateY(0);

+     transition-delay: var(--delay, 0s);

+ 
+ /* Only hide elements when JS is ready to animate them */
+ .js-ready .animate-on-scroll {
+     opacity: 0;
+     transform: translateY(30px);
+ }
+ 
+ .js-ready .animate-on-scroll.visible,
+ .animate-on-scroll.visible {
+     opacity: 1;
+     transform: translateY(0);
+ }

---

## Farmers Market App Competitive Analysis

Here's what exists in the market:

---

### **Direct Competitors (Market Discovery Apps)**

| App | Focus | Key Features | Gap |
|-----|-------|--------------|-----|
| **Farmer's Market U.S.** | US market locator | Find markets, hours, products, Apple Maps integration | No social features, US only |
| **Farmers' Market Locator** | US directory (6,800+ markets) | Search by state/city, hours, products | Basic listing, no community |
| **Soko** | Full-featured market app | Pre-order, notifications, payments, discover markets | Closest competitor, but no "who's going" social |
| **FarmersMrkt** | Single market app (Ellington) | Vendor showcase, events calendar, social media | Hyper-local, not scalable |

---

### **Adjacent Competitors (Farm-to-Consumer Platforms)**

| Platform | Model | Features |
|----------|-------|----------|
| **LocalLine** | B2B for farms | Online storefront builder for farms, order management |
| **Barn2Door** | Farm e-commerce | Subscriptions, delivery/pickup, payments |
| **Harvie** | CSA management | Customizable farm shares, pick-your-own box |
| **Farmigo** (defunct) | Online farmers market | Direct farm connections (shut down) |

---

### **Retail Competitors**

| App | Reality |
|-----|---------|
| **Sprouts Farmers Market** | Grocery chain app, not actual farmers markets |
| **Whole Foods/Instacart** | Grocery delivery, "local" branding but not direct-to-farmer |

---

### **Key Market Gaps Your App Fills**

1. **🚫 No Social Layer** — None of the existing apps have "who's going" or friend coordination features
2. **🚫 No Canada Focus** — Almost all apps are US-centric (USDA data)
3. **🚫 No Community Building** — Existing apps are transactional, not social
4. **🚫 No Cross-Market Vendor Tracking** — Can't follow a vendor across different markets
5. **🚫 Schedule Reminders** — Most are just directories, no proactive notifications

---

### **Locavore's Unique Value Proposition**

Your app combines:
- ✅ Market discovery (like Farmer's Market Locator)
- ✅ Pre-order/purchase (like Soko)
- ✅ **Social coordination** (like Meetup/Facebook Events) ← **UNIQUE**
- ✅ Vendor relationships across markets ← **UNIQUE**
- ✅ Canada-focused ← **UNIQUE**

**Bottom line:** The social "who's going" feature is your key differentiator — nobody else is treating farmers markets as a **community experience** rather than just a shopping destination.

-                         &lt;div class="decision-card"&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-before"&gt;
-                                 &lt;span class="decision-label"&gt;Initial Idea&lt;/span&gt;
-                                 &lt;p&gt;Simple market list with times&lt;/p&gt;
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-arrow"&gt;→&lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-after"&gt;
-                                 &lt;span class="decision-label"&gt;Final Decision&lt;/span&gt;
-                                 &lt;p&gt;Date badges + "X friends going"&lt;/p&gt;
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-reason"&gt;
-                                 &lt;strong&gt;Why:&lt;/strong&gt; Social proof drives attendance. Seeing friends going creates FOMO and commitment
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="decision-card"&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-before"&gt;
-                                 &lt;span class="decision-label"&gt;Initial Idea&lt;/span&gt;
-                                 &lt;p&gt;Market detail with vendor list only&lt;/p&gt;
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-arrow"&gt;→&lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-after"&gt;
-                                 &lt;span class="decision-label"&gt;Final Decision&lt;/span&gt;
-                                 &lt;p&gt;"Who's Going" section front and center&lt;/p&gt;
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-reason"&gt;
-                                 &lt;strong&gt;Why:&lt;/strong&gt; The social element is the differentiator. People go to markets for community, not just products
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="decision-card"&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-before"&gt;
-                                 &lt;span class="decision-label"&gt;Initial Idea&lt;/span&gt;
-                                 &lt;p&gt;Separate "Markets" and "Social" tabs&lt;/p&gt;
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-arrow"&gt;→&lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-after"&gt;
-                                 &lt;span class="decision-label"&gt;Final Decision&lt;/span&gt;
-                                 &lt;p&gt;Social indicators integrated into market cards&lt;/p&gt;
-                             &lt;/div&gt;
-                             &lt;div class="decision-reason"&gt;
-                                 &lt;strong&gt;Why:&lt;/strong&gt; Context matters. Show friends going right where users browse markets
-                             &lt;/div&gt;

-     &lt;!-- Design Principles Section --&gt;
-     &lt;section class="section principles-section" id="design"&gt;
-         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
-             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;DESIGN PRINCIPLES&lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;Core Principles That Guided Every Decision&lt;/h2&gt;
-             
-             &lt;div class="principles-grid"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="principle-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-icon"&gt;👥&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Community First&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Farmers markets are social experiences, and the app should amplify human connection.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-applications"&gt;
-                         &lt;h4&gt;How this informed design:&lt;/h4&gt;
-                         &lt;ul&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;"Who's going" social feed&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Friend activity visibility&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Easy invite &amp; coordination&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Shared market experiences&lt;/li&gt;
-                         &lt;/ul&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="principle-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-icon"&gt;📅&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Never Miss a Market&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Tracking multiple markets with different schedules should be effortless.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-applications"&gt;
-                         &lt;h4&gt;How this informed design:&lt;/h4&gt;
-                         &lt;ul&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Clear date/time badges&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Reminder notifications&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Favorite markets list&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Calendar-style browsing&lt;/li&gt;
-                         &lt;/ul&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="principle-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-icon"&gt;🔍&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Vendor Continuity&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Help users find their favorite vendors across different markets.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-applications"&gt;
-                         &lt;h4&gt;How this informed design:&lt;/h4&gt;
-                         &lt;ul&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Vendor profiles across markets&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Follow favorite vendors&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;"Where are they this week?"&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Product availability alerts&lt;/li&gt;
-                         &lt;/ul&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="principle-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-icon"&gt;💚&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Local Impact&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Make the positive impact of local shopping visible and motivating.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="principle-applications"&gt;
-                         &lt;h4&gt;How this informed design:&lt;/h4&gt;
-                         &lt;ul&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Markets attended counter&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Farmers supported stats&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;CO₂ savings tracking&lt;/li&gt;
-                             &lt;li&gt;Community leaderboards&lt;/li&gt;
-                         &lt;/ul&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
-         &lt;/div&gt;
-     &lt;/section&gt;

-     &lt;!-- User Journey Section --&gt;
-     &lt;section class="section journey-section"&gt;
-         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
-             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;USER JOURNEY&lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;From Discovery to Delight&lt;/h2&gt;
-             &lt;p class="section-subtitle animate-on-scroll"&gt;A five-stage journey designed to build trust while minimizing friction&lt;/p&gt;
-             
-             &lt;div class="journey-timeline"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;1&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Discover Markets&lt;/h3&gt;
-                         &lt;p&gt;User opens app and sees upcoming farmers markets in their area with dates and times&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;😊 Curious&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;2&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;See Who's Going&lt;/h3&gt;
-                         &lt;p&gt;Notice friends are attending a market, see vendor lineup, check what to expect&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;🤩 Excited&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;3&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Mark as Going&lt;/h3&gt;
-                         &lt;p&gt;Tap "I'm Going," invite friends, set a reminder for market day&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;😄 Committed&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;4&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Coordinate &amp; Plan&lt;/h3&gt;
-                         &lt;p&gt;Message friends to coordinate arrival time, check vendor products in advance&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;🤝 Connected&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.5s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;5&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Market Day Success&lt;/h3&gt;
-                         &lt;p&gt;Enjoy the market with friends, track impact, discover new vendors to follow&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;🥳 Delighted&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-             &lt;div class="journey-insights animate-on-scroll"&gt;
-                 &lt;h4&gt;Journey Design Insights&lt;/h4&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="insights-grid"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="insight"&gt;
-                         &lt;strong&gt;Social Proof:&lt;/strong&gt; Stage 2's "who's going" feature is crucial. Seeing friends creates FOMO and drives attendance commitment.
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="insight"&gt;
-                         &lt;strong&gt;Emotional Arc:&lt;/strong&gt; The journey builds from curiosity to excitement to social connection, ending with community fulfillment.
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="insight"&gt;
-                         &lt;strong&gt;Friction Points:&lt;/strong&gt; We made "I'm Going" prominent and easy to undo, reducing commitment anxiety.
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
-         &lt;/div&gt;

-     &lt;!-- Usability Testing Section --&gt;
-     &lt;section class="section usability-section"&gt;

-             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;USABILITY TESTING&lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;Validating the Design&lt;/h2&gt;
-             &lt;p class="section-subtitle animate-on-scroll"&gt;Task-based testing with 5 participants revealed key insights&lt;/p&gt;
- 
-             &lt;div class="usability-overview animate-on-scroll"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;5&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;Participants Tested&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;92%&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;Task Completion Rate&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;4.2&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;Avg. Satisfaction (1-5)&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;78&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;SUS Score (Good)&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-             &lt;div class="usability-findings"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll"&gt;
-                     &lt;span class="finding-type success"&gt;SUCCESS&lt;/span&gt;
-                     &lt;h4&gt;"I'm Going" Was Instantly Understood&lt;/h4&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;5/5 users immediately understood the social commitment feature. The button placement and labeling required zero explanation.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Keep primary CTA prominent on market cards&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
-                     &lt;span class="finding-type success"&gt;SUCCESS&lt;/span&gt;
-                     &lt;h4&gt;Date Badges Drove Quick Scanning&lt;/h4&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Users praised the calendar-style date badges. "I can see what's happening this Saturday in 2 seconds" - Participant 3&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Visual date indicators work better than text-only&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
-                     &lt;span class="finding-type issue"&gt;ISSUE FOUND&lt;/span&gt;
-                     &lt;h4&gt;Friend Invite Flow Had Friction&lt;/h4&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;3/5 users expected to invite friends directly from the market card, not from within the detail page. Extra tap felt unnecessary.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Iterated: Added quick-invite button to market cards&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
-                     &lt;span class="finding-type issue"&gt;ISSUE FOUND&lt;/span&gt;
-                     &lt;h4&gt;Vendor Filtering Was Hidden&lt;/h4&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Users wanted to filter markets by vendor type (produce, baked goods, crafts) but couldn't find the option easily.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Iterated: Added filter chips to market list header&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
-                     &lt;span class="finding-type insight"&gt;INSIGHT&lt;/span&gt;
-                     &lt;h4&gt;Social Proof Increased Intent&lt;/h4&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;"Seeing that 3 friends are going makes me want to go too" - 4/5 users mentioned FOMO as a motivator for marking attendance.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Social proof is the key differentiator&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.5s"&gt;
-                     &lt;span class="finding-type insight"&gt;INSIGHT&lt;/span&gt;
-                     &lt;h4&gt;Impact Stats Created Emotional Connection&lt;/h4&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Users loved seeing "Farmers Supported" and "Markets Attended" in their profile. It made them feel part of something bigger.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Gamification elements increase engagement&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
-         &lt;/div&gt;

-     &lt;!-- Design Challenges Section --&gt;
-     &lt;section class="section challenges-section"&gt;
-         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
-             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;DESIGN CHALLENGES&lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;UX Obstacles &amp; Solutions&lt;/h2&gt;
-             &lt;p class="section-subtitle animate-on-scroll"&gt;Key design challenges and how I addressed them&lt;/p&gt;
- 
-             &lt;div class="challenges-grid"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
-                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;01&lt;/span&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Multiple Markets, One Interface&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Cities have dozens of farmers markets with different schedules, locations, and vendors, which can be overwhelming to track&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Calendar-style date badges, location-based sorting, favorite markets list, and clear "This Week" grouping to surface what's relevant now&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
-                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;02&lt;/span&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Social Without Being Creepy&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Users want to know who's attending, but location-based social features can feel invasive&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Opt-in "I'm Going" model: you only appear if you actively mark attendance. Friends-only visibility options. No real-time location tracking&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
-                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;03&lt;/span&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Vendor Continuity Across Markets&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Users find a great vendor at one market but don't know where else they sell. Vendors often appear at multiple markets&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Unified vendor profiles showing all markets they attend, follow functionality with notifications, and "Where are they this week?" discovery&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-                 &lt;div class="challenge-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-header"&gt;
-                         &lt;span class="challenge-number"&gt;04&lt;/span&gt;
-                         &lt;h3&gt;Encouraging Commitment&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="challenge-body"&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-problem"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Challenge&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Users browse markets but don't commit to going, showing high intent but low follow-through&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
-                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;
-                             &lt;p&gt;Social proof ("Sarah &amp; 2 friends going"), prominent "I'm Going" CTA, reminder notifications, and FOMO-inducing friend activity feeds&lt;/p&gt;
-                         &lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
-         &lt;/div&gt;
-     &lt;/section&gt;
-

-             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;RESULTS &amp; LEARNINGS&lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;What I Accomplished &amp; Learned&lt;/h2&gt;
- 
-             &lt;div class="results-grid"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="result-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="result-number"&gt;15&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="result-label"&gt;Screens Designed&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Complete flow including markets discovery and social features&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;

-                     &lt;div class="result-number"&gt;3&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="result-label"&gt;Core Features&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Markets discovery, social going, vendor tracking&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="result-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="result-number"&gt;5&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="result-label"&gt;Social Mechanisms&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Who's going, friend activity, invites, coordination&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="result-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="result-number"&gt;1&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="result-label"&gt;Working Prototype&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Fully interactive HTML/CSS/JS simulation&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
- 
-             &lt;div class="learnings-grid"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;💡&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Trust Is the Product&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;In a marketplace connecting strangers, every design decision must answer: "Does this make users feel safe?" Verified badges, ratings, and messaging aren't just features; they're the foundation.&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🎯&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Quantify the Abstract&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;"Sustainable" means nothing until it's "2.3kg CO₂ saved." Turning eco-impact into numbers makes it real, shareable, and motivating. Gamification (Earth Guardian levels) adds emotional reward.&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🎨&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Design Signals Quality&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Users judge reliability by aesthetics before functionality. The polished green theme and Fraunces typography signal "premium" and "trustworthy," which is critical for food purchases from strangers.&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
-                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🔄&lt;/div&gt;
-                     &lt;h3&gt;Two Users, One Vision&lt;/h3&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;Designing for both farmers and buyers required understanding their opposing pain points, then finding features that solve both: direct messaging helps buyers trust AND helps farmers explain.&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
-         &lt;/div&gt;
-     &lt;/section&gt;
- 
-     &lt;!-- Reflection Section --&gt;
-     &lt;section class="section reflection-section"&gt;
-         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
-             &lt;div class="reflection-content animate-on-scroll"&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="section-label"&gt;REFLECTION&lt;/div&gt;
-                 &lt;h2&gt;Personal Takeaways&lt;/h2&gt;
-                 &lt;div class="reflection-text"&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;This project taught me that sustainable design isn't just about environmental impact. It's about creating systems that sustain trust, relationships, and communities. The Locavore movement isn't just about food miles; it's about reconnecting people with their food sources and each other.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;The most challenging aspect was designing for two fundamentally different user types with opposing needs. Farmers need efficient tools to list products and manage orders; buyers need confidence-building features and easy discovery. Finding the overlap (direct messaging, verified profiles, transparent pricing) was the key insight.&lt;/p&gt;
-                     &lt;p&gt;If I were to start over, I would conduct more in-depth farmer interviews earlier in the process. While buyer needs are well-documented in market research, farmer pain points around technology adoption and digital literacy would benefit from more ethnographic research.&lt;/p&gt;
-                 &lt;/div&gt;
-             &lt;/div&gt;
-         &lt;/div&gt;
-     &lt;/section&gt;
-

+             &lt;!-- Key Insights --&gt;
+             &lt;div class="competitive-insights"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="competitive-insight animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;🎯 The Gap&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;No existing app treats farmers markets as &lt;strong&gt;social experiences&lt;/strong&gt;. Users juggle Google Maps + group texts + calendar reminders separately.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="competitive-insight animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;💡 Our Differentiator&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Locavore is the only app with &lt;strong&gt;"Who's Going"&lt;/strong&gt; social features—see friends attending, invite others, and track your favorite vendors across multiple markets.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="competitive-insight animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;📈 Market Opportunity&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;With 20,000+ vendors and $1.2B in annual sales in Canada, even capturing 5% of engaged market-goers represents significant impact potential.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;

+     &lt;!-- Sketches Section --&gt;
+     &lt;section class="section sketches-section"&gt;
+         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
+             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;EARLY IDEATION&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;Paper Sketches &amp; Explorations&lt;/h2&gt;
+             
+             &lt;div class="sketches-intro animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                 &lt;p&gt;Before jumping into Figma, I explored dozens of layout ideas on paper. These rough sketches helped me quickly validate concepts and identify the most promising directions.&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="sketches-grid"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="sketch-card animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-placeholder"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-icon"&gt;✏️&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-label"&gt;Sketch Placeholder&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-info"&gt;
+                         &lt;h4&gt;Market List Explorations&lt;/h4&gt;
+                         &lt;p&gt;Explored card-based layouts, list views, and calendar integrations. The date badge concept emerged here—making market days instantly scannable.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="sketch-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-placeholder"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-icon"&gt;✏️&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-label"&gt;Sketch Placeholder&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-info"&gt;
+                         &lt;h4&gt;Social "Who's Going" Concepts&lt;/h4&gt;
+                         &lt;p&gt;Iterated on how to show friends attending without being intrusive. Tested avatar stacks, friend counts, and activity feeds before settling on the final approach.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="sketch-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-placeholder"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-icon"&gt;✏️&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-label"&gt;Sketch Placeholder&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-info"&gt;
+                         &lt;h4&gt;Market Detail &amp; Vendor Flow&lt;/h4&gt;
+                         &lt;p&gt;Mapped out the information hierarchy: what do users need to see first? Schedule, location, vendors, or social activity? Testing revealed social was the hook.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="sketch-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-placeholder"&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-icon"&gt;✏️&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;span class="sketch-label"&gt;Sketch Placeholder&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="sketch-info"&gt;
+                         &lt;h4&gt;Navigation &amp; IA Sketches&lt;/h4&gt;
+                         &lt;p&gt;Explored tab bar configurations, drawer navigation, and hub-and-spoke patterns. User testing showed bottom tabs with Markets as primary destination worked best.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;

+     &lt;!-- Wireframes &amp; Ideation Section --&gt;

+                             &lt;div class="decision-before"&gt;

+                             &lt;div class="decision-reason"&gt;

+                             &lt;/div&gt;

+                         &lt;div class="decision-card"&gt;

+             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;Core Principles That Guided Every Decision&lt;/h2&gt;
+             
+             &lt;div class="principles-grid"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="principle-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="principle-icon"&gt;👥&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Community First&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Farmers markets are social experiences, and the app should amplify human connection.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="principle-applications"&gt;
+                         &lt;h4&gt;How this informed design:&lt;/h4&gt;
+                         &lt;ul&gt;
+                             &lt;li&gt;"Who's going" social feed&lt;/li&gt;
+                             &lt;li&gt;Friend activity visibility&lt;/li&gt;

+                             &lt;li&gt;Shared market experiences&lt;/li&gt;
+                         &lt;/ul&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="principle-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="principle-icon"&gt;📅&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Never Miss a Market&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Tracking multiple markets with different schedules should be effortless.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="principle-applications"&gt;
+                         &lt;h4&gt;How this informed design:&lt;/h4&gt;
+                         &lt;ul&gt;

+                             &lt;li&gt;Reminder notifications&lt;/li&gt;

+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="principle-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;

+     &lt;!-- User Journey Section --&gt;

+             
+             &lt;div class="journey-timeline"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;1&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Discover Markets&lt;/h3&gt;
+                         &lt;p&gt;User opens app and sees upcoming farmers markets in their area with dates and times&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;😊 Curious&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;

+                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;🤩 Excited&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;

+                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;3&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Mark as Going&lt;/h3&gt;
+                         &lt;p&gt;Tap "I'm Going," invite friends, set a reminder for market day&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;😄 Committed&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;4&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Coordinate &amp; Plan&lt;/h3&gt;
+                         &lt;p&gt;Message friends to coordinate arrival time, check vendor products in advance&lt;/p&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="step-emotion positive"&gt;🤝 Connected&lt;/div&gt;

+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-connector"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="journey-step animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.5s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="step-number"&gt;5&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="step-content"&gt;
+                         &lt;h3&gt;Market Day Success&lt;/h3&gt;

+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="journey-insights animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                 &lt;h4&gt;Journey Design Insights&lt;/h4&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="insights-grid"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="insight"&gt;
+                         &lt;strong&gt;Social Proof:&lt;/strong&gt; Stage 2's "who's going" feature is crucial. Seeing friends creates FOMO and drives attendance commitment.
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="insight"&gt;
+                         &lt;strong&gt;Emotional Arc:&lt;/strong&gt; The journey builds from curiosity to excitement to social connection, ending with community fulfillment.
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="insight"&gt;
+                         &lt;strong&gt;Friction Points:&lt;/strong&gt; We made "I'm Going" prominent and easy to undo, reducing commitment anxiety.
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;

+     &lt;!-- Usability Testing Section --&gt;
+     &lt;section class="section usability-section"&gt;
+         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
+             &lt;div class="section-label animate-on-scroll"&gt;USABILITY TESTING&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;h2 class="section-title animate-on-scroll"&gt;Validating the Design&lt;/h2&gt;
+             &lt;p class="section-subtitle animate-on-scroll"&gt;Task-based testing with 5 participants revealed key insights&lt;/p&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="usability-overview animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;5&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;Participants Tested&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;92%&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;Task Completion Rate&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;4.2&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;Avg. Satisfaction (1-5)&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="usability-stat"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-number"&gt;78&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="usability-stat-label"&gt;SUS Score (Good)&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div class="usability-findings"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="finding-type success"&gt;SUCCESS&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;"I'm Going" Was Instantly Understood&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;5/5 users immediately understood the social commitment feature. The button placement and labeling required zero explanation.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Keep primary CTA prominent on market cards&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="finding-type success"&gt;SUCCESS&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;Date Badges Drove Quick Scanning&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Users praised the calendar-style date badges. "I can see what's happening this Saturday in 2 seconds" - Participant 3&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Visual date indicators work better than text-only&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="finding-type issue"&gt;ISSUE FOUND&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;Friend Invite Flow Had Friction&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;3/5 users expected to invite friends directly from the market card, not from within the detail page. Extra tap felt unnecessary.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Iterated: Added quick-invite button to market cards&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="finding-type issue"&gt;ISSUE FOUND&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;Vendor Filtering Was Hidden&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Users wanted to filter markets by vendor type (produce, baked goods, crafts) but couldn't find the option easily.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Iterated: Added filter chips to market list header&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.4s"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="finding-type insight"&gt;INSIGHT&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;Social Proof Increased Intent&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;"Seeing that 3 friends are going makes me want to go too" - 4/5 users mentioned FOMO as a motivator for marking attendance.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Social proof is the key differentiator&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div class="usability-finding animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.5s"&gt;
+                     &lt;span class="finding-type insight"&gt;INSIGHT&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;h4&gt;Impact Stats Created Emotional Connection&lt;/h4&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Users loved seeing "Farmers Supported" and "Markets Attended" in their profile. It made them feel part of something bigger.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="finding-action"&gt;Validated: Gamification elements increase engagement&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/section&gt;

+                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;

+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                         &lt;div class="challenge-solution"&gt;
+                             &lt;h4&gt;Design Solution&lt;/h4&gt;

+                         &lt;/div&gt;

+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;💡&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Trust Is the Product&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;In a marketplace connecting strangers, every design decision must answer: "Does this make users feel safe?" Verified badges, ratings, and messaging aren't just features; they're the foundation.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.1s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🎯&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Quantify the Abstract&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;"Sustainable" means nothing until it's "2.3kg CO₂ saved." Turning eco-impact into numbers makes it real, shareable, and motivating. Gamification (Earth Guardian levels) adds emotional reward.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.2s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🎨&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Design Signals Quality&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Users judge reliability by aesthetics before functionality. The polished green theme and Fraunces typography signal "premium" and "trustworthy," which is critical for food purchases from strangers.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="learning-card animate-on-scroll" style="--delay: 0.3s"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="learning-icon"&gt;🔄&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;h3&gt;Two Users, One Vision&lt;/h3&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;Designing for both farmers and buyers required understanding their opposing pain points, then finding features that solve both: direct messaging helps buyers trust AND helps farmers explain.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/section&gt;
+ 
+     &lt;!-- Reflection Section --&gt;
+     &lt;section class="section reflection-section"&gt;
+         &lt;div class="container"&gt;
+             &lt;div class="reflection-content animate-on-scroll"&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="section-label"&gt;REFLECTION&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;h2&gt;Personal Takeaways&lt;/h2&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="reflection-text"&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;This project taught me that sustainable design isn't just about environmental impact. It's about creating systems that sustain trust, relationships, and communities. The Locavore movement isn't just about food miles; it's about reconnecting people with their food sources and each other.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;The most challenging aspect was designing for two fundamentally different user types with opposing needs. Farmers need efficient tools to list products and manage orders; buyers need confidence-building features and easy discovery. Finding the overlap (direct messaging, verified profiles, transparent pricing) was the key insight.&lt;/p&gt;
+                     &lt;p&gt;If I were to start over, I would conduct more in-depth farmer interviews earlier in the process. While buyer needs are well-documented in market research, farmer pain points around technology adoption and digital literacy would benefit from more ethnographic research.&lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;

The icons in the Image Renamer case study come from **[Lucide React](https://lucide.dev/)**, an open-source icon library.

## How They're Incorporated

**1. Installation** - The package is listed in `package.json`:

```38:38:Create Case Study Document (1)/package.json
"lucide-react": "^0.487.0",
```

**2. Import** - Icons are imported directly by name:

```1:1:Create Case Study Document (1)/src/components/Features.tsx
import { Brain, History, Shield, Zap, Settings2, FileCheck } from 'lucide-react';
```

**3. Usage** - Icons are used as React components with className for styling:

```62:63:Create Case Study Document (1)/src/components/Features.tsx
// ... within the JSX
<feature.icon className={`w-6 h-6 ${feature.color}`} />
```

## Icons Used in the Project

| Component | Icons |
|-----------|-------|
| `Features.tsx` | Brain, Zap, History, Shield, Settings2, FileCheck |
| `Challenges.tsx` | Shield, Brain, Users, Zap |
| `Results.tsx` | Target, Award, TrendingUp, Palette |
| `UserResearch.tsx` | Target, Users, TrendingUp |

## Why Lucide?

- **Tree-shakeable**: Only imports the icons you use (small bundle)
- **Consistent styling**: All icons have same stroke width and sizing
- **React-native**: Each icon is a proper React component
- **Customizable**: Size and color via `className` (Tailwind) or inline styles

Great question! For Locavore's organic, community-focused, nature-inspired brand, here's my analysis:

## Top Recommendations

### 🥇 **Phosphor Icons** (My Top Pick)
**[phosphoricons.com](https://phosphoricons.com/)**

| Pros | Cons |
|------|------|
| 9,000+ icons - largest variety | Slightly larger bundle if not tree-shaken |
| **6 weights**: Thin, Light, Regular, Bold, Fill, Duotone | |
| Has food, nature, farm icons (leaf, plant, carrot, egg, etc.) | |
| Duotone style is perfect for Locavore's warm aesthetic | |
| Works with vanilla JS, React, Vue, or as web font | |
| MIT licensed, fully open source | |

**Why it fits Locavore**: The duotone style can use your green/terracotta palette for a cohesive, illustrative feel that matches the organic vibe.

---

### 🥈 **Lucide** (Clean & Minimal)
**[lucide.dev](https://lucide.dev/)**

| Pros | Cons |
|------|------|
| Already used in your Image Renamer project (portfolio consistency) | Fewer food-specific icons |
| Very lightweight & tree-shakeable | Single style only |
| Clean, professional, modern | |
| 1,500+ icons | |
| Great documentation | |

**Why it fits**: If you want a minimal, professional look. Would need to use generic icons for food categories.

---

### 🥉 **Tabler Icons** (Great Balance)
**[tabler.io/icons](https://tabler.io/icons)**

| Pros | Cons |
|------|------|
| 5,000+ icons | Single stroke style |
| Includes food/nature icons (apple, carrot, leaf, egg) | |
| Consistent 2px stroke | |
| MIT licensed | |
| Vanilla JS & React support | |

---

## Quick Comparison for Locavore's Needs

| Icon Need | Phosphor | Lucide | Tabler |
|-----------|----------|--------|--------|
| 🥬 Vegetables | ✅ Carrot, Pepper, Plant | ⚠️ Generic leaf only | ✅ Carrot, Salad |
| 🍎 Fruits | ✅ Apple, Orange, Lemon | ⚠️ Apple only | ✅ Apple, Lemon |
| 🥛 Dairy | ✅ Cow, Cheese, Bottle | ❌ None | ⚠️ Milk |
| 🥚 Eggs | ✅ Egg | ✅ Egg | ✅ Egg |
| 🍯 Honey | ⚠️ Jar/Bee | ❌ None | ✅ Honeycomb |
| 🥩 Meat | ✅ Steak | ❌ None | ✅ Meat |
| 👥 Social | ✅ Users, Heart, Chat | ✅ Users, Heart, Chat | ✅ Users, Heart, Chat |
| 🗺️ Maps/Location | ✅ MapPin, Navigation | ✅ MapPin, Navigation | ✅ MapPin, Navigation |
| 🛒 Commerce | ✅ Cart, Bag, Receipt | ✅ Cart, Bag | ✅ Cart, Bag |
| **Duotone style** | ✅ Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No |

---

## My Recommendation

**Go with Phosphor Icons** because:

1. **Variety** - Has actual food icons (not just generic shapes)
2. **Duotone** - Can use your brand colors (forest green + terracotta) for a warm, illustrative feel
3. **Flexibility** - 6 weights let you use thin for subtle UI, bold for emphasis
4. **Easy integration** - Works with vanilla HTML/JS (for the app) and could work in React too
5. **Future-proof** - If you add more screens/features, you won't run out of icons

Done! I've replaced emojis with **Phosphor Icons** throughout the Locavore app and case study. Here's what was implemented:

## Changes Made

### 1. Added Phosphor Icons Library
- Added CDN: `https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web@2.1.1`
- Created custom icon color classes:
  - `.icon-forest` (#4A7C59) - main green
  - `.icon-terracotta` (#c76f51) - warm accent
  - `.icon-amber` (#e6a756) - golden accent
  - `.icon-leaf` (#7ab18a) - light green

### 2. Icon Styles Used
- **Duotone** (`ph-duotone`) - for illustrative icons (categories, features)
- **Fill** (`ph-fill`) - for action states (favorites, stars, checkmarks)
- **Regular** (`ph`) - for outlines and inactive states

### 3. Key Icon Replacements

| Category | Before | After |
|----------|--------|-------|
| **Food** | 🍅🥕🍎🥬🥚🍯 | `ph-orange`, `ph-carrot`, `ph-apple-logo`, `ph-leaf`, `ph-egg`, `ph-jar` |
| **Location** | 📍 | `ph-map-pin` |
| **Social** | 👥👋 | `ph-users`, `ph-hand-waving` |
| **Commerce** | 🛒🏪 | `ph-shopping-cart`, `ph-storefront` |
| **Actions** | ⭐♡✓🔔 | `ph-star`, `ph-heart`, `ph-check`, `ph-bell` |
| **UI** | 🕐📅📱💬 | `ph-clock`, `ph-calendar`, `ph-device-mobile`, `ph-chat-teardrop` |
| **Nature** | 🌿🌱🌍 | `ph-leaf`, `ph-plant`, `ph-globe-hemisphere-west` |

### 4. JavaScript Updates
- Updated favorite button toggle to switch between `ph` and `ph-fill`
- Updated dynamic "I'm Going" button text to use icon HTML
- Updated greeting to use `ph-hand-waving` icon
